title: Canonical Artifact Envelope and Lineage Contract
purpose: Define the versioned envelope carried by every major BIE artifact so source, decisions, models/tools, configuration, parents, hashes and QA evidence remain traceable end-to-end.
acceptance_criteria: No production artifact can exist without artifact_id,type,schema_version,run_id,created_at,content_hash,producer,parent_refs,provenance_summary.
Artifact lineage can trace any released video/game artifact to source evidence and generating decisions.
Invalid/missing lineage is gate-failing, not warning-only.
